create_mujoban_level: create a MujobanLevel instance from a Sokoban ASCII art level string using single_level_generator
regenerate_maze: regenerate the MujobanLevel maze by calling the regenerate method to load the next level from the generator
convert_ascii_to_text_grid: convert a Sokoban ASCII art level string to a Mujoban text grid format using _ascii_to_text_grid_level
get_level_dimensions: get the height and width properties of a MujobanLevel instance to retrieve the maze grid dimensions
query_boxes_and_targets: query the num_boxes and num_targets properties of a MujobanLevel to get box and target counts
